title: Being woken up in the real world randomly and constantly once you become lucid .

classification.question_topic: Reports repeated awakenings triggered by real-world events when becoming lucid or feeling they are figuring something out in dreams; suggests possible interference.
classification.skip_reason: No in-dream locations, scenes, entities, or spatial structure described; content is about repeated real-world awakenings during lucid/important-feeling dreams.

meta.author_theory: Whenever they become lucid or feel they are figuring out something important in dreams, they are repeatedly awakened by real-world disruptions (phone calls despite DND, fire alarm, loud noises, unexpected concerned call), implying something prevents remembering/figuring things out.

extraction.extraction_notes: Phenomenology present is primarily sleep/dream-transition disruption: repeated awakenings coinciding with lucidity/“figuring things out.” No describable Mall World environments/locations were provided.
